scope:
Learn necessary signature clauses from failed global H realizations.

The master is the C1/corner/signature model. The subproblem additionally
imposes eigenvectors, triangles, boundary profiles, C2 and minc>=4. Only H
selectors are assumed in the subproblem, never the master's proposed edges.
An UNSAT assumption core therefore forbids that partial signature assignment
for every edge completion. A satisfiable relaxation or UNKNOWN is not blocked.
Only an UNSAT master with these valid clauses excludes the fixed Gram.

line_profiles.scope:
Linearize common neighbours using complete outside rows at a root line.

For any root line r, its 36 neighbours split into the prescribed components
of size 6s. An outside vertex has exactly s neighbours in each component,
two neighbours of each colour. Its two colour-zero neighbours are fixed
by its label. Enumerate all four remaining neighbours (two in each star)
subject to these counts and already-forced edges. This uses no local seed.

All 276 C2 equations on pairs of star vertices split into an inside sum
over 24 vertices and an outside sum over 60 vertices. Profile indicators
make the latter linear. The few inside products are retained exactly.
For different components the inside sum is zero and the target is 1
for the same colour, 2 otherwise.

exact_triangle_structure.scope:
Exact lambda=1 using actual triangle indicators, plus triangle cores.

A Gamma edge sharing a root label already has its common neighbour in
N(o), so lies in no Gamma triangle. Every other Gamma edge lies in exactly
one. Indicators are equivalent to ALL THREE edges being present; merely
choosing an edge decomposition into triangles would be insufficient.

Under C1, every Gamma vertex then lies in exactly five Gamma triangles.
For the 60 vertices outside any root line and its neighbourhood, each
vertex lies in at least one core triangle, and there are exactly 32-t(l)
such triangles, where t(l) is the triangle count in the cubic neighbourhood.
If c(l)=6, those 60 vertices partition into exactly twenty triangles.
